title: Singapore Manufacturing Demand Planning
thesis: Snowflake turns daily demand and plan exceptions for Straitsline Components, a fictional Singapore manufacturer, into exception and stockout KPIs, 7-day stockout risk scores, a network demand forecast, forecast error anomalies and grounded AI answers, all on one governed platform.

persona.name: Rachel Ong
persona.role: Head of Demand Planning, Straitsline Components (fictional)

talking_points: Exception-free day rate, plan exceptions raised, stockouts and demand value in SGD for 40 planning items stocked at DCs in Tuas, Woodlands, Pasir Panjang, Changi and Tampines.
Every KPI is a numerator over a denominator in a curated dynamic table, so it can be traced back to item-day rows.
The exception-type chart shows which exceptions end in stockouts and which are always resolved, such as port congestion at the Pasir Panjang and Tuas DCs next to the container terminals.
tabs.call_out: One governed set of demand planning KPIs, traceable to source rows

transition.line: Which planning items should the supply planners watch first?

talking_points: Snowflake ML classification scores each planning item's probability of a stockout in the next 7 days.
The holdout line shows precision and recall on the most recent labelled days, against the base rate.
The forecast projects network-wide demand in units for 14 days, and anomaly detection flags forecast error outliers per item.
tabs.call_out: Honest, evaluated ML inside the data platform

transition.line: Are our planning controls keeping up?

persona.name: Rachel Ong
persona.role: Head of Demand Planning, Straitsline Components (fictional)

talking_points: Plan review adherence, supplier confirmation coverage and pending confirmations frame the control gaps.
Plan review adherence against stockouts by planning item shows where missed reviews and stockouts move together; it is an association, not proof of cause.
The action memo drafts three prioritised actions from the KPI, planning item, exception-type and risk tables only.
show: Plan review adherence and supplier confirmation coverage
tabs.call_out: Grounded draft actions, with a human in the loop

transition.line: What happens when a rush order arrives right now?

talking_points: Live partner order-line events land in RAW.LIVE_DEMAND, from the simulator or from Amazon Data Firehose through Snowpipe.
The Snowflake alert logs EXCEPTION events with an SOP hint and the item's current risk band, then emails the on-call supply planner.
tabs.call_out: From rush order to planning case in one platform

persona.name: Rachel Ong
persona.role: Head of Demand Planning, Straitsline Components (fictional)

talking_points: The Cortex Agent uses Cortex Analyst over the semantic view for metrics, and Cortex Search over 14 synthetic plan exception handling SOPs.
Each answer shows the generated SQL and the SOPs it cited.

persona.name: Rachel Ong
persona.role: Head of Demand Planning, Straitsline Components (fictional)
